title: The Nash Hideaway | Cozy 2BR Retreat
description:
Welcome to The Nash Hideaway, a newly built 2-bedroom guesthouse in East Nashville. Thoughtfully designed with vaulted wood ceilings, a full kitchen, cozy living space and a door opening to the balcony. Enjoy your own private, peaceful retreat while staying close to East Nashville’s restaurants, coffee shops and local favorites, with easy access to downtown. Perfect for couples, friends, families or longer stays.
